title: 20% off Eames Lounge Chair & Ottoman (Tall, Walnut, Black Leather) $12,990 (Was $15,440) + $270 Metro Delivery @ Living Edge
body:
Deal: 20% off Eames Lounge Chair & Ottoman (Tall, Walnut, Black Leather) $12,990 (Was $15,440) + $270 Metro Delivery @ Living Edge

[SBOB] I'm too poor, so I just bought the delivery part so my neighbours might think I'm wealthy
[salmon123] Kids are high yielding assets.
Ask Jeffrey Epstein.
[watdahelly] lmao. bruh…
Jokes like this won't land here, we're all prudish boomers. Hence why this comment and yours will get down voted.
[cook99] Dammit, spent all my money sending RAM to Sam this week
[Satchimo] Is this kind of like a high yield investment vehicle chair?
[supergolf10] Do we still live in a society where this sort of thing makes sense?
[Satchimo] Presumedly the seller is planning on making cents (probably a lot of them).
[marcozmitch] I think the deal is a shitty deal.
Buying a piece of furniture for this price is not justified unless there is some business purpose or something similar.
I do understand it is a longstanding, authentic and historic piece of furniture.
[Big L] A $13K chair is where you draw the line?
[marcozmitch] Much lower.
Replicas of designs are fine.
Comfort is king.
All the neg voters are full of it.
We have a Replica, Le Corbusier LC4 Chaise Longue at home, which would be perfectly comfortable if it had armrests.
You will see below, that this piece of quality furniture can be purchased for a little over $1,000.
But as I note; the furniture is narrow-sized, and your arms have nowhere to go.
So, the Nordic-style and Scandinavian-designed recliner chairs or replica designs will do.
https://www.replicafurniture.com.au/replica-le-corbusier-lc4…
[duodeta] Its for luxury bum not for mine. Mine is fine with 49 bucks one.
[DealHunted] Wow, you're rich! Mine is sitting on something that I got for free!
[simontadaa] 20% off? Gross… I prefer paying full price so I can tell people how much it is. Bigger number is always better right?
[Creamsoda] For sure. Just like the big black Range Rover drivers who thinks owning a green badge is owning the road.
[Water Bearer] Its the same sort of thing with Loewe tvs back in the day. Charge a premium for something that's actually worse than the competition. Rely on the company name to sell. Charge whatever they want, even if its $10K more. I've sat in these chairs, I wouldn't call them the most comfortable chair by any means. Just like the Loewe tv which Sony would trump easily, with their clarity, upscaling, colour accuracy, etc.
[Big L] They're not that price because they're the most comfortable
[D-grey] If you bought this why are you in Ozbargain?
[NonAccount] They're frugal, not poor. And OzBargain but Gina Rinehart bracket
[MILKAPIG] There's quite many frugal medical specialists, lawyers and tech / engineers with 300k salaries on here (usually lurking to get good picks) who may want a good chair to relax on
[Pricebeat] RBA board members calling urgent meeting tomorrow, after this post.
[Allan] These are not comfortable at all. Price seems crazy now though when they used to go for a few grand
[cafeman] You might be thinking of the replicas? They were normally around $850 to $1,500. An authentic Eames chair was between $8,500 and $11,000 in 2020, they've always been expensive. Without doing the maths, the increase since then looks pretty close to inflation.
[Pete Gabitas] A friend has a replica. Extremely comfortable. Maybe it's a good one.
[cafeman] I bought one of the more expensive ones about a decade ago. Personally, I love it - it’s my reading chair. It’s not for everyone (my wife hates sitting in it) but it’s great for me.
It needs a small pillow behind your lower back to actually be comfortable but with that, it’s great. I’ll happily read / use a laptop for a few hours in it.
[Allan] Tested both replicas and real
My first post back in 2014 was for a replica one at Officeworks
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/131398
Real one was at Costco Casula so plenty of time to check it out back then. Really not comfortable.
[afayd] I tried the authentic one at a show room and thought the same. I wouldn’t purchase it at $200.
[salmon123] I tried the authentic one at a show room
Look at Mr Fancy Pants shopping at a show room with 10k+ chairs.
[afayd] Looks like you don't know that it's the same brand that manufactures the aeron. While there trying the aeron, might as well also try something that costs 7x more.
[kaybrr] The Tall is the one that is comfortable vs the normal which is cramped tbh
[gakko] Yeah agree. Relatives had one. Didn't rate it.
[Justin-aus] Agree, I used to have one. Wasn’t comfy at all…they do look nice though
[Disabled-User] Is the "wow" for you realising you're rich?
[Alee91] Thanks OP, sold my house and bought 20 ottomans
[Domingo] Reckon I could get the person behind me in line to offer to pay for mine for me?
[Polska Kielbasa] The shipping alone costs more than my whole living room set.
[Nick K] Is this suitable for my townhouse back yard?
[justtoreply] I don't know if I sat in a real or fake (but the family is pretentious so I think real) but it wasn't comfortable at all
[ozbking] Actually if they’re pretentious, more likely to be fake
[SpicyPeanut] Did anyone get the aldi version from 2 years ago?
[kdinosaur] People who have 13k to buy a chair usually are not ozbargainer.
They are something else, even not human, a complicated form of life
[SBOB] I think the price of the chair is probably more of a factor.
[Water Bearer] No. Delivery is the biggest problem by far. Outrageous prices for delivery. Makes me sick that companies are charging so much just for transport. The chair is fine, also a great deal, very cheap lol.
[eug] It's not flat-pack furniture or thin like a TV, they're delivered mostly or fully assembled so they'll take up a lot more room in a truck.
I imagine being such an expensive, awkwardly-shaped item that is easy to scuff during transport or unloading into your home, delivery will cost more due to the higher risk of damage involved.
[whichwhatwho] There is not one compelling argument that would convince me these are worth anything more than a few hundred bucks. Yes I know they are iconic. It's some mdf and some leather.
[boozed] Arguments about value aside, it most certainly isn't made of MDF lol
[Souvis] I mean it's just Plywood with a vaneer and a little bit of leather. the people buying this are either on the good stuff or have so much money they can't tell the difference between $15k and $150
[afayd] I literally tried one with an open mind at a showroom. Uncomfortable and not very functional. I wouldn’t buy it at $200 tbf.
[dwarves] Irrelevant given you don’t have $200 tho
[Souvis] For what possible reason are these so expensive, the materials would only be like 200-300 max. how the hell do they reach 13-15k wtf
[mini2] This was $13k not too long ago.
It’s not all that comfy either. It just look good.
To be completely honest, a $2k Stressless probably feels more comfortable to sit on.
[AustriaBargain] Mlik crates bundled together with frayed strips of bungie cord is the best furniture, it is functional, covers two of the three Rs, and yo can repair it yourself just by sneaking around cafes early in the morning.
[gviddy] I bought the Aldi imitation about 4 years ago and it still looks perfect. So many people complained that it would not last a year. Only cost me $300 I think it was.
[vita] Read it as $270 delivered and wasn't sure if I should grab one at that price, well…
[haidasalami] This is not a every day bum rester.
This is a replica work of art for a connoisseur. I mean you got to have the right house, lighting and landscape to really frame it.
[Roe Jogan] u can get the replicas for like 1k which are pretty decent
[Poppy Sweeting] Damn more expensive than my car, then again a rtx5090 also costs more so…
[Dollar General] At this price I would expect the leather to come from cows high up in the Bavarian mountains where they don’t use barb wire so the hide has no marks
[thousandsuns] Got the replica for $800ish. Very good chair. Love it! Makes me feel like Steve Jobs when I feel poor and deflated :(
[troubadour] Problem is they don't come with mounting brackets for my private jet.
[BrainSeeker] There was that moment where I saw the item before the price and had that slight pop of excitement to see the bargain price.
Well then.
[NSWbargains] Cheapskate bargainers, show me your budget option. Not paying that price for something that isn't even comfortable.
[Tacooo] Herman Miller Aeron looking like a really good deal now.
[bakemon0] this costs more than my clapped out falcon
[justtoreply] The Falcon will also help get you laid just as much. Simply a different demographic of partner.
[Scrooge McGoose] My therapist has one. I'm helping paying it off.
[mr_asstight] Too cheap. This is a timeless classic and shouldn't be discounted like this. Cowards
[deathtokiller] 13k and they cant even be bothered to use real wood. just vaneer over plywood.
[Gonltruck] Rumour has it, the padding is made of paneer
[Aap Ke Papa] I’m sure I still would’ve thought multiple times before buying it even if it was $1299
[SydStrand] I own some other HM pieces and while I don't mind paying for heritage furniture, I never looked twice at an Eames chair. Even if prices were slightly less insane, they really just aren't very comfortable chairs. There is zero tilt or adjustability, so while your legs are elevated, your back is always upright, and there's no headrest. Unless you're loaded and completely obsessed with mid-century design (and the rest of your house fits it), then it's a hard pass.
[YoursTruly] Yes - we want to move backwards….to Mid century furniture…lol
[Nedman] I purchased two of these for my HiFi room, well not these but Chinese knock offs.
I thought the ones I purchased were expensive at just over $800.
[Felicity111] bought 2. sorry in advance for the next interest rate hike
[FuRyZ] Ironically, the kind people that would buy these chairs… couldnt care less if they are on sale or not. The difference between the full price and the sale price would be nothing more than a rounding error to them.
